features.name: Unarmed Warrior
features.description:
When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, while not wearing heavy armor and not wielding weapons or a shield:

* Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + STR bludgeoning damage (1d8 at 10th level, 1d10 at 18th level).
* When you use the Attack action with one or more unarmed strikes, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action.

features.name: Resilient Fighter
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you add your CON modifier (min 1) to any death saving throw. Also, you can use Second Wind a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Regain all uses on short or long rest.

features.name: Uncanny Fortitude
features.description:
Beginning at 7th level, if damage reduces you to 0 HP, you can make a CON save (DC 5 + damage taken) — on success, drop to 1 HP instead (doesn't apply to critical hits). Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

Also, when you use Second Wind, you now regain HP equal to 1d10 + fighter level + CON modifier.

features.name: Debilitating Blow
features.description: At 10th level, when you hit one target with two unarmed strikes on the same turn, you can use a bonus action to force a CON save (DC 8 + prof + STR mod). On failure, the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.

payload.name: Debilitating Blow
payload.description: After hitting one target with two unarmed strikes this turn: CON save or target has disadvantage on its next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

features.name: Withstand Death
features.description:
At 15th level, when you are reduced to 0 HP, you can use Second Wind as a reaction (if uses remain). You can choose whether to do this before or after Uncanny Fortitude triggers.

Also, when you roll a 1 on a death saving throw, it counts as one failure instead of two.

payload.name: Withstand Death
payload.description: When reduced to 0 HP, use Second Wind as a reaction (if uses remain). Can be used before or after Uncanny Fortitude.

features.name: Opportunistic Brawler
features.description: Starting at 18th level, you have advantage on initiative rolls. When a creature enters a space within 5 feet of you, you can make one opportunity attack against it with an unarmed strike. You have a number of reactions per turn equal to your proficiency bonus, but these extra reactions can only be used for these opportunity attacks.
